summary: An avatar that opens the signed-in account: its card, a few actions, other accounts to switch to and Sign out.

props.name: account
props.description: Who is signed in: the avatar, and the card at the top of the menu.

props.name: accounts
props.description: Every signed-in account, the current one included, listed to switch between.

props.name: onSwitch
props.description: Called with the account picked from the list.

props.name: actions
props.description: Rows under the card, such as Settings.

props.name: onAddAccount
props.description: Called from the Add account row under the list.

props.name: onSignOut
props.description: Called from the Sign out row at the bottom.

props.name: status
props.description: A dot on the avatar for presence.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius of the popup and its rows. Inherits the nearest `Shape`.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes. `merge` folds them in last, so one here replaces the component's own class for the same utility.

props.name: focus
props.description: The focus outline. `true` draws it, `false` removes it, and a string of Yumma CSS utilities restyles it on every focusable part of the component, which is more than `className` reaches. Removing it outright and putting nothing back fails WCAG 2.4.7.

props.name: container
props.description: Where the popup is rendered. Defaults to `document.body`; pass an element to portal somewhere else, such as inside a frame.
